Deliverable: One-page question hypothesis variables and expected counter-result
Gate: Question is narrow measurable and could be disproved
DefenseQuestion: What evidence would make you reject your own hypothesis?

Deliverable: Annotated matrix of at least five primary sources with claim method data and limitation
Gate: Every claim is linked to a source and no source is represented only by its abstract
DefenseQuestion: How is a literature gap different from a topic nobody has searched carefully?

Deliverable: Preregistered protocol with data split metrics baselines seeds compute budget and stopping rule
Gate: Protocol fixes decisions that could otherwise move after seeing results
DefenseQuestion: Which researcher degrees of freedom could bias this study?

Deliverable: Versioned code raw outputs analysis script and figure comparing feature scaling or learning-rate conditions
Gate: Results reproduce from one documented command and include uncertainty across runs
DefenseQuestion: Why is one successful training run not sufficient evidence?

Deliverable: Abstract introduction method results limitations references and reproducibility statement
Gate: Every conclusion is supported by a table figure or explicitly labeled inference
DefenseQuestion: What is the strongest claim this note supports and what claim would overreach?

Deliverable: Replication charter naming the exact XGBoost or classical-ML claim dataset metric and tolerance
Gate: Claim is feasible on available hardware and has an official or reconstructable baseline
DefenseQuestion: What must match the original study before a result counts as replication?

Deliverable: Locked environment data provenance baseline command and initial result table
Gate: Independent baseline runs and all deviations from the paper are documented
DefenseQuestion: How can an implementation difference masquerade as a failed replication?

Deliverable: Repeated experiment with confidence interval and comparison to stated tolerance
Gate: Analysis distinguishes exact reproduction directional reproduction and failure to reproduce
DefenseQuestion: What conclusion is justified if the effect direction matches but magnitude does not?

Deliverable: Ablation over at least two assumptions plus failed-run log
Gate: Negative and unstable results are preserved instead of silently discarded
DefenseQuestion: Which hidden assumption has the greatest effect on the reported result?

Deliverable: Full report with deviations uncertainty threats and artifact instructions
Gate: A second person could follow the instructions without private context
DefenseQuestion: Why is a failed replication not automatically proof that the original paper is wrong?

Deliverable: One-page proposal for a text representation retrieval or small-model ablation
Gate: Contribution is a focused empirical finding rather than a vague model improvement
DefenseQuestion: What is new about the comparison rather than the individual methods?

Deliverable: Claim-centered literature map and explicit unresolved question
Gate: Closest prior work and expected differences are stated fairly
DefenseQuestion: Which prior result most threatens the novelty of this study?

Deliverable: Experiment matrix controlling data model budget seeds and evaluation slices
Gate: Only the intended factors vary and multiple comparisons are addressed
DefenseQuestion: What confounder would make the ablation uninterpretable?

Deliverable: Tested pipeline pilot results runtime estimate and go-no-go decision
Gate: Pilot validates instrumentation without being reused as final test evidence
DefenseQuestion: Why should pilot results not determine the final hypothesis threshold?

Deliverable: Raw run ledger aggregate statistics per-slice results and error analysis
Gate: Report variance failures and practical effect size not only best score
DefenseQuestion: What result would be statistically visible but practically irrelevant?

Deliverable: Six-to-eight-page draft plus one-page adversarial review and revision list
Gate: Review identifies unsupported claims missing baselines and reproducibility gaps
DefenseQuestion: If you were Reviewer 2 what is the strongest rejection argument?

Deliverable: Proposal comparing data quality retrieval evaluation monitoring or serving under a fixed budget
Gate: Question has a real workload baseline and measurable quality-performance tradeoff
DefenseQuestion: Why does this need a research study rather than a product benchmark?

Deliverable: Versioned public dataset judgment protocol inter-rater or consistency check and leakage audit
Gate: Evaluation labels and exclusions are documented before system comparison
DefenseQuestion: How could your relevance judgments favor one system design?

Deliverable: Protocol defining quality latency cost slices statistical test and release threshold
Gate: Primary and secondary metrics are separated and baseline choices justified
DefenseQuestion: Which metric is primary and why cannot it be changed after results?

Deliverable: Reproducible baseline and candidate pipelines with parity and access-control tests
Gate: Both systems receive equivalent inputs budgets and evaluation treatment
DefenseQuestion: What implementation asymmetry could create a false improvement?

Deliverable: Per-query or per-example deltas uncertainty slices and qualitative failure taxonomy
Gate: Aggregate improvement cannot hide important regressions
DefenseQuestion: Which failures are invisible in the mean score?

Deliverable: Latency throughput memory cost and workload-distribution measurements with instrument controls
Gate: Client bottlenecks cache artifacts warmup and measurement boundaries are tested
DefenseQuestion: How do you know the benchmark measures the system rather than the harness?

Deliverable: Eight-page draft artifact README reproducibility checklist and internal review
Gate: Claims jointly satisfy quality and systems evidence and limitations are explicit
DefenseQuestion: Would the conclusion survive a different workload distribution?

Deliverable: Three candidate questions with novelty risk feasibility value and ethical-risk matrix
Gate: Candidates are grounded in completed evidence rather than trend chasing
DefenseQuestion: Which candidate has the best contribution-to-risk ratio?

Deliverable: Structured review of closest work with claim graph and unresolved contradictions
Gate: Search covers primary work negative evidence and adjacent terminology
DefenseQuestion: What existing paper could make this project redundant?

Deliverable: Two-to-three-page proposal with contribution hypothesis baselines resources and stop conditions
Gate: External reviewer can challenge scope before major implementation
DefenseQuestion: What result would still be useful if the main hypothesis fails?

Deliverable: Pilot artifact risk register compute estimate and revised protocol
Gate: Pilot tests feasibility and measurement validity without claiming final results
DefenseQuestion: Which feasibility risk could invalidate the entire project?

Deliverable: Preregistered final protocol data card model or system card and analysis plan
Gate: No major metric baseline or exclusion changes occur without recorded rationale
DefenseQuestion: What analytical decision remains vulnerable to hindsight bias?

Deliverable: Correctness-tested baseline candidate and reproducible environment
Gate: Unit integration parity and seed controls pass before expensive runs
DefenseQuestion: How do you know an observed gain is not a correctness bug?

Deliverable: Immutable raw outputs run ledger failures and preliminary blinded analysis
Gate: Failed runs and resource consumption are retained
DefenseQuestion: What operational failure pattern could bias surviving runs?

Deliverable: Independent repetitions additional slices and finalized aggregate analysis
Gate: Results are stable enough to distinguish signal from run variance
DefenseQuestion: How would the conclusion change under the worst plausible uncertainty?

Deliverable: Ablations stress tests alternative baseline and out-of-distribution check
Gate: Robustness tests target the mechanism claimed by the paper
DefenseQuestion: Which ablation most directly tests your causal story?

Deliverable: Threat model data and license audit limitations negative-impact analysis and mitigations
Gate: Limitations are specific and not a generic disclaimer
DefenseQuestion: Who could be harmed if readers overgeneralize this result?

Deliverable: Complete methods tables figures captions and reproducibility appendix
Gate: Every figure is generated by a checked-in script from preserved data
DefenseQuestion: Could a reader reproduce every reported number?

Deliverable: Title abstract introduction related work methods results discussion conclusion and references
Gate: Abstract claims exactly match the strongest supported evidence
DefenseQuestion: Which sentence in the abstract is easiest to challenge?

Deliverable: Two structured reviews author response and prioritized revision plan
Gate: At least one reviewer is independent and technically qualified where possible
DefenseQuestion: Which criticism changes the research conclusion rather than only presentation?

Deliverable: Revised manuscript code data instructions licenses figure scripts and reproducibility checklist
Gate: Artifact works in a clean environment and authorship or AI assistance is disclosed per venue
DefenseQuestion: What prevents an independent researcher from reproducing the study?

Deliverable: Venue-fit matrix honest readiness decision final archive and next-work plan
Gate: External expert review precedes venue submission and no publication outcome is promised
DefenseQuestion: Why is this venue appropriate and what evidence says the work is ready?
